gaps.sentence: We mustn't miss ___ this exhibition — it ends on Sunday.
She couldn't resist ___ the last biscuit.
I saw him ___ the wall and disappear into the garden.
gaps.explanation: see/hear + object + bare infinitive = the complete action; -ing = the action in progress. Both readings possible here; the bare infinitive is expected.

gaps.sentence: It started ___ just as we left the house.
gaps.explanation: start/begin take either -ing or to-infinitive; with continuous or states, 'to' is preferred. Both accepted.

gaps.sentence: Don't forget ___ the plants while we're away.
gaps.explanation: forget + to-infinitive = fail to do something you should do.

gaps.sentence: She decided ___ the job offer in Berlin.
gaps.explanation: decide takes the to-infinitive: decided to accept.

gaps.sentence: They've postponed ___ the new bridge until spring.
He went on ___ even after the audience had left.
gaps.explanation: go on + -ing = continue the same activity; go on to do = do something next.
